LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_SettingAlertDesc: Show "Bills stalled", "Construction stalled", "Colonists idle", "Hauling stalled", "Food rotting uncollected" and "Patients untended" alerts on the right when something has been stalled, or someone idle, for most of the last day.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_SettingProbesDesc: Ask modded work givers why they can't do a bill. Always off while the Multiplayer mod is active.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_NoFix: No one-click fix for this. Use Jump to and check it in the game.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Working: Someone was working on this bill.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_BrokenDown: The {BENCH} is broken down and waiting for repair.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_InteractionBlocked: The spot where a worker stands to use the {BENCH} is blocked.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_InteractionBlockedBy: The spot where a worker stands to use the {BENCH} is blocked by {THING}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_NoColonists: There are no colonists on this map.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_WorkTypeDisabled: Nobody has {WORK} enabled in the Work tab.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_PawnRestriction: The bill's worker restriction excludes everyone who could do it, including {PAWN}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_SkillRange: {PAWN} is the best candidate with {SKILL} {LEVEL}, but the bill only allows {MIN}–{MAX}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_SkillMin: {PAWN} is the best candidate with {SKILL} {LEVEL}, but the recipe needs at least {MIN}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_AreaRestriction: {PAWN} could do the bill, but their allowed area ({AREA}) keeps them away from the {BENCH}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_WorkersUnavailable: {PAWN} could do the bill but is downed, drafted or having a mental break.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_NoneOnMap: There is no {ING} on the map.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_ExcludedByBillFilter: There is {ING} on the map, but the bill's ingredient filter excludes it.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Forbidden: The usable {ING} is forbidden or outside the worker's allowed area.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_OutsideRadius: {COUNT} {ING} is available, but the nearest is {DIST} tiles from the bench. The bill only searches {RADIUS}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Reserved: The usable {ING} is reserved by someone else.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Unreachable: The usable {ING} can't be reached from the bench.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_NoStockpileAccepts: The bill takes {PRODUCT} to the best stockpile, but no stockpile accepts it, so finished items are dropped next to the bench.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_SpecificStockpileReject: The bill takes {PRODUCT} to {STOCKPILE}, which doesn't accept it, so finished items are dropped next to the bench.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_BenchBusy: {PAWN} is using the bench for another bill ({BILL}).
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Outcompeted: {PAWN} could do this, but spent the stall on work that comes before {STALLED} in their work order: {SHARES}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_OutcompetedOnce: {PAWN} was busy with {WORK}, which comes before {STALLED} in their work order.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_OffDuty: Everyone who could do this was off duty: sleeping, eating, on recreation or outside work hours.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_SameOrLowerRank: Someone could do this, but was idle or on work that ranks the same or lower. The game may be picking closer jobs first.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Waiting: Materials and a worker are available, but nobody has started this bill. Workers were busy with other jobs.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Generic: This bench is handled by a modded work giver. Colony Doctor can't tell why it's stalled yet.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_AlertExplanation: These bills have been stalled for at least half of the last day. Click to open the Bottlenecks tab and see why.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_Working: Someone was delivering materials, clearing the site or building.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_Waiting: Nothing blocks it and a builder is available, but nobody has started. Workers were busy with other jobs.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_Incapable: No colonist is capable of construction.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_WorkTypeDisabled: Nobody has Construction enabled in the Work tab.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_SkillTooLow: {PAWN} is the best builder with {SKILL} {LEVEL}, but the {THING} needs {MIN}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_WorkersUnavailable: {PAWN} could build it but is downed, drafted or having a mental break.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_BlockedPlant: {THING} is in the way and has to be cut first.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_BlockedItem: {THING} is in the way and has to be hauled away first.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_BlockedBuilding: {THING} is in the way and has to be deconstructed first.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_BlockedBuildingStuck: {THING} is in the way and your colony can't deconstruct it.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_BlockedRock: {THING} is in the way and has to be mined first.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_BlockedRockNoMiner: {THING} is in the way and has to be mined, but no builder has Mining enabled.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_NotEnough: Not enough {MAT}: {SHORT} more needed, {USABLE} usable on the map.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_Forbidden: The {MAT} on the map is forbidden or outside allowed areas ({SHORT} short).
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_MatUnreachable: The {MAT} on the map can't be reached from the site ({SHORT} short).
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_Reserved: The {MAT} on the map is reserved by other jobs ({SHORT} short).
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_AlertConstructionExplanatio: These construction sites have been stalled for at least half of the last day. Click to open the Bottlenecks tab and see why.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_FixSide_Radius: Workers may walk further to fetch ingredients.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_FixChange_SkillRange: Allowed skill {FROMMIN}–{FROMMAX} → {TOMIN}–{TOMAX}, so {PAWN} (skill {LEVEL}) can do it
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_FixSide_SkillRange: Less skilled workers may make lower quality items.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_FixSide_Restriction: Whoever is free may take the bill, not only the one you chose.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_FixChange_DropOnFloor: Product goes to: {FROM} → drop on floor
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_FixSide_DropOnFloor: Products pile up next to the bench.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_FixSide_AllowIn: {WHERE} will also take {PRODUCT} from elsewhere on the map.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_FixSide_Unforbid: Colonists may also use or haul these for other jobs.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_FixSide_Priority: {PAWN} will do this before {OTHER}, so {OTHER} may wait longer.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_NothingIdle: Nobody was idle while on duty in this range.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Idle_NoWork: {PAWN} has no work type enabled. Turn some on in the Work tab.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Idle_Blocked: All the work {PAWN} could do is blocked. Longest stalled: {PROBLEM} ({REASON}).
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Idle_BlockedHauling: All the work {PAWN} could do is blocked: the items waiting to be hauled are forbidden or already reserved.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Idle_Nothing: There was nothing to do in {PAWN}'s enabled work.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Idle_NotTaken: There was {WORK} work, but {PAWN} didn't take it. It may need a skill or allowed area they lack, or be reserved by someone else.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Idle_Unseen: Colony Doctor can't yet see whether there was {WORK} work for {PAWN}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_AlertIdleExplanation: These colonists were idle for at least half of their working time in the last day. Click to open the Bottlenecks tab and see why.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_HaulStacks: {STACKS} stacks lying around, {WAITING} waiting over an hour
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Haul_Working: Being hauled, or only just dropped.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Haul_NoStorage: No stockpile or shelf accepts {THING}. Allow it in a stockpile's filter, or build storage for it.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Haul_StorageFull: Every stockpile or shelf that accepts {THING} is full. Make a stockpile bigger, or allow {THING} somewhere else.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Haul_Unreachable: No hauler can reach the {THING}. It may be walled off, behind a locked door or outside allowed areas.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Haul_NoColonists: There are no colonists to haul it.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Haul_Incapable: Nobody in the colony is capable of hauling.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Haul_Disabled: Nobody has Hauling enabled in the Work tab.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Haul_Unavailable: Everyone who hauls is downed, drafted or in a mental state.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_AlertHaulingExplanation: Items of these types have been left lying around for at least half of the last day. Click to open the Bottlenecks tab and see why.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_AlertRottingExplanation: Nobody is hauling these, and some stacks will rot within a day at the current temperature. Click to open the Bottlenecks tab and see why.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Grow_Working: Being sown or harvested, nothing to do, or the work has been waiting under an hour.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Grow_Unpowered: The grower can't take {PLANT} right now. It may need power.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Grow_Skill: Sowing {PLANT} needs Plants {NEED}. The best available grower, {PAWN}, has {HAVE}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Grow_Unreachable: No available grower can reach it.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Grow_Incapable: Nobody in the colony is capable of growing.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Grow_Disabled: Nobody has Growing enabled in the Work tab.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Grow_Unavailable: Everyone who grows is downed, drafted or in a mental state.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_OrderFresh: All placed within the last hour
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Order_Working: Someone is on it, or the orders are new.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Order_Forbidden: Every waiting order is on something forbidden ({COUNT}). Colonists won't touch forbidden things.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Order_Unreachable: No available worker can reach any of the waiting orders.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Order_Incapable: Nobody in the colony is capable of {WORK}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Order_Disabled: Nobody has {WORK} enabled in the Work tab.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Order_Unavailable: Everyone who does {WORK} is downed, drafted or in a mental state.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Order_NoHuntingWeapon: No available hunter carries a ranged weapon, or the only ones that do also wear a shield. Hunters need a ranged weapon and no shield.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Order_TameSkill: Taming the {ANIMAL} needs Animals {NEED}. The best available handler, {PAWN}, has {HAVE}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Research_Working: Someone is researching it, or it has only just stopped.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Research_NeedBench: {PROJECT} can only be researched at a {BENCH}, and the colony has none on this map.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Research_NoBench: There is no research bench on this map.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Research_Unpowered: The {BENCH} has no power, and this project needs a powered bench.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Research_Forbidden: The {BENCH} is forbidden. Colonists won't research at a forbidden bench.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Research_Unreachable: No available researcher can reach a suitable research bench.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Area_One: {PAWN} could do this ({WORK}), but their allowed area ({AREA}) doesn't include it.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Area_Many: Everyone who could do this ({WORK}) is kept out by their allowed area: {PAWN} ({AREA}) and {OTHERS} more.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_FixSide_AllowEverywhere: {PAWN} may walk into danger outside {FROM}, for example during raids.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Patient_Working: Tended, being tended, or needs nothing right now.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Patient_NoCare: {PAWN}'s medical care is set to "No care". Doctors won't tend them until it is changed in the Health tab.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Patient_DownedNotInBed: {PAWN} is down and not in a bed. Doctors tend people in bed, so someone must carry them to one first. Check there is a free bed they may use.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Patient_UpNotInBed: {PAWN} is up and about. Doctors only tend people lying in bed; they rest in bed on their own if bed rest is allowed for them.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Patient_Incapable: Nobody in the colony is capable of doctoring.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Patient_Disabled: Nobody has Doctor enabled in the Work tab.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Patient_Unavailable: Everyone who doctors is downed, drafted or in a mental state.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Patient_OnlySelf: {PAWN} is the only doctor available, and self-tend is off for them.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_AlertPatientsExplanation: These people have needed tending for a while and no doctor has come. Click to open the Bottlenecks tab and see why.
